defect.description: The sparse-flow profile deliberately reduced min_sell_prints to one, but the hard tape-imbalance toxicity gate treated any single compatible SELL print as signed_imbalance=-1 and therefore maximally toxic. The two rules contradicted each other: the very one-print contra-flow needed to establish immediate fill relevance was deterministically rejected before shadow admission.
defect.why_threshold_lowering_is_not_the_fix: Post-cost edge and conservative fill proxy were already well above the authorized floors. The rejection came from a degenerate one-observation toxicity statistic, not from the edge or fill threshold.
defect.economic_risk: Removing toxicity entirely would increase adverse-selection risk; therefore the fix only delays the hard imbalance veto until at least two tape observations while retaining the full soft toxicity penalty in adjusted edge, book-confidence filtering and at-touch-only placement for sparse flow.
